name: image-gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible image gateway. Wraps an upstream CPA (cliproxyapi) service and exposes 5 fixed model specs with credits-based billing.

KEY_HASH_SECRET.description: REQUIRED. 32+ char pepper for hashing api keys. Generate via openssl rand -hex 32

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: REQUIRED. 16+ char secret for /admin/* routes. Must NOT be 'change-me-please'.

CPA_BASE_URL.description: Internal address of the cliproxyapi service in this project.

CPA_API_KEY.description: Optional bearer token for CPA's api-keys list.
